name: Aparador chico con patas en V
adaptations: T18 plywood in place of the pine plywood (no change in the plan)
finish danish-oil used for the wax-oil (no wax-oil id)
straight two-layer legs under an apron instead of V legs
door fronts drawn with vertical router grooves in place of the micro-grooves; top-edge notch drawn as a finger notch
anchored to the wall assumed: the photos do not show it; 800 mm high on straight legs that stand on only 230 mm of depth, the engine says it can tip forward
notes: Aparador chico de dos puertas embutidas con frente microranurado, una repisa detrás de cada puerta y patas en V. Sirve de arrimo, estante o bar.
